mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust household demand, which boosts corporate sales and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 3.5 (annualized) in the prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 470,000 million dollars signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite low RSAFS, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5 AND PAYEMS < 100.0 in the prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth above 2.0% annualized over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite high GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
